local Table1 = workspace.Tables.Table1 -- Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77
local HitTrajectory = Table1.Guides.HitTrajectory -- Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77

local maxSegments = 5 -- Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77
local segmentLength = 10 -- Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77
local trajectoryParts = {} -- Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77

local function clearTrajectory() -- Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77
    for _, part in pairs(trajectoryParts) do -- Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77
        if part and part.Parent then -- Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77
            part:Destroy() -- Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77
        end -- Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77
    end -- Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77
    trajectoryParts = {} -- Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77
end -- Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77

local function updateTrajectory() -- Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77
    clearTrajectory() -- Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77

    local startPos = HitTrajectory.Position -- Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77
    local direction = HitTrajectory.CFrame.LookVector.Unit -- Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77
    local currentPos = startPos -- Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77

    for i = 1, maxSegments do -- Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77
        local nextPos = currentPos + direction * segmentLength -- Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77

        local line = Instance.new("Part") -- Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77
        line.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, segmentLength) -- Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77
        line.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(currentPos, nextPos) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -segmentLength / 2) -- Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77
        line.BrickColor = BrickColor.Green() -- Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77
        line.Anchored = true -- Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77
        line.CanCollide = false -- Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77
        line.Parent = workspace -- Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77

        table.insert(trajectoryParts, line) -- Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77
        currentPos = nextPos -- Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77
    end -- Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77
end -- Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77

HitTrajectory:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"):Connect(updateTrajectory) -- Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77 Creador By Vixx77
